title: 'Hartland Bridge Delegation' play
description: To celebrate the bridge’s anniversary, Weldon Matthews wrote a play for the library board depicting the Hartland Delegation’s appeal to the government for a bridge in Hartland on March 15, 1898—an effort that ultimately proved unsuccessful. This was performed at the anniversary dinner.  Standing (left to right) Leonard Orser, Alton Shaw, Dalton Ellis, John Glass, Mark Atwater, Barb Shaw and Ann Ellis. Sitting Aage & Bea Skaarup (off stage) Elta Rideout, Ralph Shaw and Ruth Sawler.
